class.name: ArkherQualityDirector
class.brief_description: Native Arkher quality director: dynamic resolution with hysteresis, FSR/FSR2 upscaling, per-tier rendering settings and a thermal model that keeps sustained load inside the device's thermal budget.
class.description: Arkher pillar 1 ("photoreal on any phone"), native version. Unlike [ArkherAutoQuality] (which only recommends), this director applies the changes: it drives the root [Window]'s content scale (dynamic resolution), selects the upscaler ([constant UPSCALER_AUTO] uses FSR) and applies per-tier settings (shadows, SDFGI, SSAO, SSIL, glow, volumetric fog, SSR, reflections, MSAA) to [member world_environment] and every [Light3D] in the scene. [b]Thermal model ("teto térmico"):[/b] [method get_thermal_state] rises with sustained rendering load and falls while the frame budget is met. When it crosses [member thermal_warning_threshold], the effective max scale is lowered (down to 50% of [member max_scale] at full heat) and the [signal thermal_warning] signal is emitted. Tune [member thermal_heat_rate] per device — start conservative on the Itel A70 (the Arkher mobile floor) and loosen on mid/high phones. [b]Presets:[/b] save one [ArkherQualityPreset] per target device (e.g. [code]presets/a70.tres[/code]) and load it with [method apply_preset]. In stable Godot builds, the equivalent is the script-based [code]ArkherQualityProfile[/code] from the [code]arkher_quality[/code] addon.

method.name: apply_preset
method.description: Loads a saved quality profile (per-device calibration) and applies it immediately: target FPS, scale bounds, upscaler, the per-tier arrays and the thermal rates. The current scale is clamped into the new bounds.

method.name: get_current_scale
method.description: Current dynamic-resolution scale (between [member min_scale] and the effective max scale).

method.name: get_current_tier
method.description: Currently applied tier: 0 = low, 1 = medium, 2 = high.

method.name: get_effective_max_scale
method.description: [member max_scale] reduced by the current thermal ceiling. The director will never scale above this value.

members.member: Turns the director on/off. When disabled, the last applied scale/tier is kept.
Target frames per second. The director lowers the render scale until it can hold this.
Lowest render scale allowed (0.4 = 40% of the window resolution).
Highest render scale allowed before the thermal ceiling.
Seconds below the target FPS before the scale steps down (hysteresis against flapping).
Seconds above the target FPS before the scale steps back up.
How much the scale decreases per step.
How much the scale increases per step (smaller than [member step_down] to avoid oscillation).
How the lower internal resolution is upscaled to the window. [constant UPSCALER_AUTO] uses FSR in this engine.
FSR sharpness (0 = smooth, 1 = sharper).
When the window's content scale mode is still disabled, the director configures it (viewport mode) so its scale actually applies to 3D.

The [WorldEnvironment] whose [Environment] effects are toggled per tier. When empty, the director auto-discovers [b]every[/b] [WorldEnvironment] in the scene and applies the tier to all of them (multi-environment scenes).
Shadows on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code], applied to every [Light3D] in the scene.
Shadow fade distance per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code].
Environment reflections on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code] (0 = disabled, 1 = reflections from background).
SDFGI on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code].
SSAO on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code].
SSIL on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code].
Glow on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code].
Volumetric fog on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code].
SSR on/off per tier [code][low, medium, high][/code].
MSAA per tier: 0 = disabled, 1 = 2x, 2 = 4x, 3 = 8x.
Thermal state rise per second at full load. With the default, a phone pinned below target FPS reaches full heat in roughly 25 seconds.
Thermal state fall per second while the frame budget is met.
Thermal state at which the ceiling starts lowering [method get_effective_max_scale] and [signal thermal_warning] fires.
Profile loaded automatically on startup (for example, the floor-device profile of your target phone). Leave empty to use the inspector values.

signal.name: scale_changed
signal.description: Emitted whenever the render scale changes.

signal.name: tier_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the applied quality tier changes (0 = low, 1 = medium, 2 = high).

signal.name: quality_changed
signal.description: Emitted after a tier change with the current scale and tier.

signal.name: thermal_warning
signal.description: Emitted when the thermal state crosses [member thermal_warning_threshold] ([code]true[/code]) or drops back under it ([code]false[/code]). Use it to show a "thermal mode" indicator or to reduce audio/CPU work too.

constants.constant: Uses FSR in this engine (the recommended default).
FidelityFX Super Resolution 2.0 (temporal; best quality, higher cost).
